fees.source: https://www.nps.gov/blri/planyourvisit/peaks-otter-cg.htm (NPS campground data behind the page, via the NPS data API: 'Peaks of Otter Campground Fee' 30.00) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233403/rates (2026 season, RV NONELECTRIC $30), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233403 notice ('There are no showers. No electric, water, or sewer hook-ups are available.'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 139 sites: 51 RV, 88 tent-only (NPS); 60 reservable, 79 first-come. Catalogued RV driveways run 18-77 ft, 29 pull-through; the NPS says Virginia law limits RVs to 45 ft and trailers to 28.5 ft (65 ft combined).

sites.source: https://www.nps.gov/blri/planyourvisit/peaks-otter-cg.htm (NPS campground data: totalSites 139, rvOnly 51, tentOnly 88; rvInfo 'VA state laws limit RVs to 45' in length') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233403 ('60 sites available for advance reservation, there are 79 first-come, first-served campsites') + RIDB campsite catalog for 233403 (trip_data/ridb_campsites.json, fetched 2026-10-20), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Camp store is the concession Sharp Top Country Store, within walking distance (camping supplies, firewood, ice); Peaks of Otter Lodge restaurant nearby.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233403 ('flush toilets, drinking water and a dump station'; 'There are no showers'; Sharp Top Country Store 'within walking distance') + https://www.nps.gov/blri/planyourvisit/peaks-otter-cg.htm (NPS amenities: Flush Toilets - seasonal, Showers None, Dump Station, Camp Store Yes - seasonal, Laundry No), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 2026 season Friday, May 22 - Sunday, October 25 ('Closed for Winter' October 26 - May 21). The dates move each year.

season.source: https://www.nps.gov/blri/planyourvisit/peaks-otter-cg.htm (operating hours from the NPS data behind the page: 'Friday, May 22, 2026 - Sunday, October 25, 2026', exception 'Closed for Winter' 2026-10-26 to 2027-05-21), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 60 sites reservable on recreation.gov (up to six months ahead per NPS); 79 first-come, booked in person at the campground kiosk (9:30 AM-6 PM), status not shown online. 'Peaks of Otter Campground almost always has campsites available.' Reservations close 1 day before arrival; 30 days per year.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233403 (description; facility_rules reservationCutOff 1 'day(s) prior to arrival', maxConsecutiveStay 30, maxStay 30 days 'Each Year'; notice 'Some campsites at this facility are available on a first-come, first-served basis') + https://www.nps.gov/blri/planyourvisit/peaks-otter-cg.htm (NPS reservationInfo 'up to six months in advance', kiosk hours), read 2026-10-21

discounts.source: https://www.nps.gov/blri/planyourvisit/peaks-otter-cg.htm (NPS fee description: 'Holders of the Interagency Senior, Access, Golden Age, or Golden Access passes are entitled to a 50% discount on the base fee'), read 2026-10-21

summary: Confirmed $30/night, no hookups, recreation.gov booking, six-month window and Senior/Access 50% discount. Added 2026 season May 22 - Oct 25, 139 sites (51 RV, 79 first-come), pull-throughs, RVs to 45 ft per NPS, flush toilets, water, dump, camp store, no showers, 30-night limit, booking closes the day before arrival.
